item.title: Charles Yang (楊嘉猷)
item.description: Charles Yang (楊嘉猷 / Yang Jia-you) Charles Yang (楊嘉猷; LINE display Chia you) is the founding president (創會會長) of the Taiwanese American Historical Society (TAHS / 台美人歷史協會).

item.title: Yang Hsin (楊信)
item.description: Yang Hsin (楊信) Yang Hsin (楊信, born 1944), also known in English as Jackson Yang, is a Taiwanese American entrepreneur and community leader.

item.title: Yi Sen Lee (李意盛)
item.description: Yi Sen Lee (李意盛) Yi Sen Lee (李意盛) serves as 特別助理 (Special assistant), TAHS 2025 of the 台美人歷史協會).

item.title: Yuan-Chen Li (李元貞)
item.description: Yuan-Chen Li (李元貞) Yuan-Chen Li (李元貞) is a Taiwan-born composer and educator listed in the |TAH Foundation Who’s Who (#1088, 2016/06) and musician series (#12, 2014/10).

item.title: Dr. Yunching Yeh Davis (葉芸青)
item.description: Dr. Yunching Yeh Davis (葉芸青) Dr. Yunching Yeh Davis (葉芸青) is 主席 of the |NTPC 執委會 for 2025/26 (西南區代表; ntpc-usa.org).

item.title: Zhang Xuanxin (張宣信)
item.description: Zhang Xuanxin (張宣信) Zhang Xuanxin (張宣信) is a member of the |Taiwanese American Historical Society community.
